output.one_liner: Astro is a web framework for building fast, content-driven websites with modern developer experience.
output.description: Astro is a JavaScript web framework optimized for building fast, content-driven websites like marketing sites, blogs, and e-commerce. It uses server-first rendering and island architecture to deliver lightweight HTML with minimal JavaScript. The framework supports multiple UI libraries and integrates with various CMSs and deployment platforms.

icp.pain: Slow website performance and complex full-stack setups for content sites
icp.buying_trigger: Need to improve Core Web Vitals or migrate from a monolithic CMS

differentiators: Server-first rendering with zero JavaScript by default
Astro Islands architecture for selective interactivity
Supports multiple UI frameworks with no lock-in
Built-in optimizations for images, prefetching, and view transitions
proof_points: 66% of real-world Astro sites pass Core Web Vitals (vs 30% for Next.js) - found on homepage
Over 50,000 GitHub stars - inferred from GitHub badge in README
Used by companies like NordVPN - mentioned on homepage

voice.sample_phrase: Astro is a website build tool for the modern web — powerful developer experience meets lightweight output.

gaps: No direct demo link on homepage

confidence.notes: High confidence; primary sources fully analyzed
